title: PlayerSnapshot
description: Read-only snapshot of an OSRS character, written by the RuneLite plugin and read by the MCP server. Bump schemaVersion on any breaking change.

coins.description: Coins carried in the inventory plus coins in the last-seen bank.

bank.description: Bank contents as of the last time the bank was open, possibly from an earlier session; null when the bank has never been seen. Placeholders and bank fillers are excluded.

quests.description: Quest name to progress, refreshed periodically rather than on every write.

questPoints.description: Total quest points, refreshed alongside quests. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it. Null until the first quest refresh after the plugin starts.

fairyRingsUnlocked.description: Whether Fairytale II has progressed far enough (Fairy Godfather's permission, quest varbit 2326 >= 40, or the quest finished) to use fairy rings. Says nothing about the dramen/lunar staff that travel still needs unless the elite Lumbridge & Draynor diary is done. Refreshed alongside quests. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it. Null until the first quest refresh after the plugin starts.

combat.description: Combat setup and the current fight. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

target.description: Who the player is interacting with (Actor#getInteracting); null when not interacting, which is how a finished fight reads. Another player is reduced to kind and combat level: never named.

npcId.description: Tells same-named NPC variants apart; null for players.

hpPercent.description: Health bar fill, rounded up; null until the bar has been shown, and always null for players.

attackStyle.description: In-game style name of the selected style, e.g. "Aggressive", "Longrange", "Defensive Casting"; null when unknown.

spellbook.description: Null when the game reports a book outside these four.

activePrayers.description: Display names of the prayers that are on, in prayer-book order.

status.description: Run energy, weight, poison, disease and timed effects. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

poisonDamage.description: Damage of the next poison or venom hit; null when not poisoned.

effects.description: Effect name (e.g. "Stamina", "Antifire", "Super antifire", "Antipoison", "Antivenom", "Overload", "Divine super combat", "Teleblock") to whole seconds left as of capturedAt. Effects that count down in multi-tick steps (antifires, overload, stamina, antipoison, antivenom) are an upper bound accurate to one step.

gameRevision.description: Game build the client runs (Client#getRevision). Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

progress.description: Progress read straight from the client, so it does not depend on WikiSync. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

task.description: The assigned task; null when none is assigned.

creature.description: Task name from the game cache, e.g. "Cave crawlers"; null if the cache lookup failed.

location.description: Area the task is restricted to (Konar's tasks); null when it can be done anywhere.

streak.description: Consecutive tasks completed for the current master's streak (Krystilia and Mortimer keep their own).

diaries.description: In-game diary region name (e.g. "Lumbridge & Draynor", "Kourend & Kebos", "Western Provinces") to its completed tiers; every region present, empty when no tier is complete.

sessionXp.description: XP gained since login (a world hop keeps the session); null while the login stat sync is landing.

gained.description: Skill name to XP gained; skills without gains are left out.

worldTypes.description: Rulesets of the current world; empty on a standard free-to-play world. pvp and bounty_hunter match find_nearest's worldType. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

nearbyPlayers.description: Number of other players in the loaded scene; an aggregate only, never who or where. Null while no scene is loaded. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

grandExchange.description: Occupied Grand Exchange slots in slot order; empty when none are occupied. Null for ironmen, who cannot trade. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

slot.description: Slot number as the game shows it.

status.description: COMPLETE and CANCELLED offers still hold items or coins until the player collects them.

pricePerItem.description: Offered price per item, in coins.

quantity.description: Items the offer was placed for.

quantityTraded.description: Items bought or sold so far.

coinsTraded.description: Coins spent on a buy offer, or received for a sell offer, so far.

birdhouses.description: The four Fossil Island bird house spaces as last read on the island, possibly sessions ago; null until the character has been seen there. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

checkedAt.description: When the plugin last read the spaces on Fossil Island.

location.description: The space as RuneLite's Time Tracking names it, e.g. "Mushroom Meadow (North)".

state.description: BUILT is a bird house without seeds, which catches nothing.

birdhouse.description: The bird house's item name; null when empty or unknown.

readyAt.description: When a seeded bird house is full (50 minutes after seeding); null unless seeded, and null when it was seeded while the plugin was not watching.

teleportCooldowns.description: When Home Teleport and the minigame teleport (Grouping) can next be cast, from the game's record of the last cast, so it stays valid across sessions. A time in the past means ready now. The game stores the cast to the minute, so a ready time can be up to a minute early. Optional: plugins older than this field omit it.

homeReadyAt.description: 30 minutes after the last Home Teleport; null when never cast.

minigameReadyAt.description: 20 minutes after the last minigame teleport; null when never cast.
